definitions.explanation: the main or final stage of a competition, as opposed to preliminary rounds

examples.japanese: {本選|ほんせん}に{進|すす}んだ。
{予選|よせん}を{通過|つうか}して{本選|ほんせん}に{出場|しゅつじょう}する。
examples.english: To pass the preliminaries and compete in the finals.

examples.japanese: {本選|ほんせん}は{来週|らいしゅう}{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: The main competition will be held next week.

notes:
USAGE:
- {本選|ほんせん}に{進|すす}む/{出|で}る (to advance to/enter the finals)
- {本選|ほんせん}{出場|しゅつじょう} (participation in the finals)

COMPETITION STAGES:
- {予選|よせん} (preliminary round, qualifier)
- {本選|ほんせん} (main round, finals)
- {決勝|けっしょう} (final match)
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう} (semifinal)

CONTEXTS:
Used in various competitions: sports tournaments, music competitions, cooking contests, academic competitions, etc.

RELATED:
- {予選|よせん} (preliminary round - antonym)
- {決勝戦|けっしょうせん} (final match)
- {準々決勝|じゅんじゅんけっしょう} (quarterfinal)
